summary: The claim highlights the critical role of E-Rate funding in supporting libraries, which rely on high-speed internet for various services. The library emphasizes the importance of E-Rate to maintain affordable internet access for patrons, including job seekers and students. The claim suggests that without E-Rate funding, the library would struggle to provide essential services and resources.

claims.argument: Without E-Rate funding, libraries would not be able to afford high-speed internet, affecting patrons' access to library resources.
claims.evidence_quote: Without E-Rate our library would not be able to afford high speed internet which will affect patrons who rely on the library for network access for school and for work.
